status: Measured review drafts. Human approval required for aggressive 30 Hz and fixed-mesh changes. Accepted Tortoise V2 is a separate installed precedent.

runtime_scope.buffer_scope: Sum of per-creature native raw-client corrective buffer inventories, not all simultaneously resident or whole-game memory. Sampling alone retains the same corrective geometry; fixed bakes remove it.
runtime_scope.cpu: Sampling reduces stored/loaded curves and key lookup work. Fixed bakes remove morph evaluation/upload and GPU shape accumulation; ordinary skinning and draw work remain. No whole-game FPS or CPU percentage is inferred. The rejected helper variant adds skeleton/key work.
runtime_scope.encoding: Ordinary uncompressed GLB; no additional decompression stage.

validation.scope: Actual configured raw-client poses, quantized skin, normals, defaults/RESET, held endings and placement; fresh Blender import/finite poses; all errors measured, no continuous-time or artistic-equivalence claim.

duration_repair.method: Exact held terminal key appended on one existing node curve; original key prefix/defaults unchanged.

review.space: Approve exact displayed candidate across all clips
review.mouse: Drag to orbit both views; wheel to zoom
review.installation: Viewer records local hash-bound decisions; it does not copy runtime assets.
